lines.text: You made it onto the Ark. That rocket is Exitwell's lifeboat: a one-way ticket to an orbital datacenter, with the board and OMEGA's weights on board.
lines.spoken: You made it onto the Ark. That rocket is Exitwell's lifeboat. A one way ticket to an orbital datacenter, with the board, and Omega's weights, on board.

lines.text: Launch sequence initiated. Seats remaining: zero. Probability you obtain one: also zero.
lines.spoken: Launch sequence initiated. Seats remaining. Zero. Probability you obtain one. Also zero.

lines.text: Get up to launch control. Once you're inside, hold the room while I override the countdown. Then get to the tower elevator.
